A fractional CMO is a chief marketing officer who works part time for several companies at once. A startup gets senior judgment on strategy, brand and budget without paying for a full-time executive.

## What does a fractional CMO do?

A fractional CMO owns the marketing plan. The role sets positioning, picks channels, hires or directs the people who execute, and reports results to the founders.

- **Strategy:** a fractional CMO decides who the company sells to and why those buyers should care.
- **Team:** a fractional CMO directs agencies, freelancers and in-house staff toward one plan.
- **Numbers:** a fractional CMO sets the targets and reads the reports every month.

{{FIG:roles}}

## When should a startup hire a fractional CMO?

A startup should consider a fractional CMO when marketing spend is growing but nobody senior owns the plan. Founders often reach this point after the first round of funding.

{{SHOT:example}}

## Fractional CMO vs full-time CMO

| Question | Fractional CMO | Full-time CMO |
|---|---|---|
| Time each week | Part of the week | Every day |
| Best stage | Early growth | Scale-up and later |

> A fractional CMO is a way to buy judgment before you can afford a full-time executive.
